description: Sistema di Allertamento - Tratti servizio di piena gestiti dall'Agenzia Regionale per la Sicurezza Territoriale e la Protezione Civile is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. A flood service on watercourses is defined as that set of preliminary activities, active control, emergency and subsequent control of the flood event. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Alert System - Full service segments managed by the Regional Agency for Territorial Security and Civil Protection" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
